frequency_question: How often do federal oversight threats against major institutional accreditors result in actual formal revocation of recognition within a short administrative window?
membership_rule: Includes formal Department of Education or equivalent federal review proceedings specifically targeting a recognized national or professional accreditor's statutory authority. Excludes voluntary relinquishments or minor probationary warnings that do not involve active revocation proceedings.

cases.name: ABA Accreditation Recognition Review (Department of Education, late 1990s)
American Bar Association Compliance Review and Threatened Decertification
ACICS (Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools) Federal Recognition Revocation

coverage_note: 3 named; captures the primary federal challenges to major institutional/professional accreditors in recent decades.
known_gaps: Lower-profile advisory committee recommendations that did not reach a formal departmental revocation order are excluded.
skeleton: Three major federal review cycles of recognized accreditors over a 30-year span, yielding one formal revocation.
validity_reason: Administrative law standards and the statutory framework governing the Department of Education's recognition of accreditors change slowly.
